newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-HudCon says Docklands "all or nothing".
newsitem.headline: RTRS-HudCon says Docklands "all or nothing".

text.p: Property group Hudson Conway Ltd said on Monday its joint bid with Lend Lease Corp Ltd to develop Melbourne's Docklands district was being made on an all-or-nothing basis.
The consortium has bid to develop all five precincts under the A$2 billion plan to redevelop Melbourne's waterfront.
"Lend Lease and ourselves are only interested if we can control all the area," Hudson Conway chief executive LLoyd Williams told reporters in Melbourne.
Hudson Conway recently raised A$130.2 million in seven-year unsecured exchangeable notes, but Williams declined on Monday to explain in detail how the funds would be used.
Hudson Conway has only said that the funds will be used to pursue major projects in Australia, for working capital and to retire debt.
Hudson Conway and Lend Lease expect to lodge a formal bid for the entire Docklands project in April or early May, Williams said.
